lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Fabiola, Marisol here. How's your Tuesday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi! Yes, now's good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the band exercises went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've had more energy, I noticed that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So did you manage to do the band exercises 4 times?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I did it! 4 out of 4 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you still have the band we gave you?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You need to do the exercises every day or you'll lose muscle.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On one hand, being so tired makes it really hard. On the other hand, you still want to make this work.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My back was hurting so I didn't push it. I didn't think I'd like it, but I do.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. Honestly I forgot about it after Tuesday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You feel like you have to do something.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So it's not that you don't care. It's that being so tired keeps getting in the way.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, my health is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've noticed it makes a difference.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've got a plan in mind already.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: After treatment I had no energy at all. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I do the band exercises 5 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 4 out of 4 days, the hard part was being so tired, and next week you're going to do the band exercises 5 times. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Fabiola, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

flags.reason: Warned about muscle loss and daily exercise without permission, which shut down the participant's expressed doubt.
Repeated the TV-watching tip verbatim after the participant had already responded, ignoring her reply and pushing advice.
Back pain was mentioned as the reason for skipping exercise and was not explored or checked for safety.

score.summary: The coach used good complex reflections (lines 14, 23, 43) and let Fabiola set her own 5-session goal, which built momentum. However, the coach persuaded twice (lines 12 and 36, the latter a verbatim repeat) and did not explore the back pain, which weakened partnership.
strengths: Line 14 and line 23 reflect ambivalence and reframe the barrier as fatigue, not lack of caring.
Line 47 'It's completely your call' supports autonomy and lets Fabiola own the 5-session goal.
Line 48 summary confirms the plan and invites correction.
coaching_tips: Line 12: replace the warning about muscle loss with a question such as 'What do you think about the band exercises now?'
Line 36: do not repeat advice already answered; reflect her reply to line 35 instead.
Line 16: ask about the back pain ('How is your back now, and what would help you exercise safely?') before moving on.
Line 30: ask permission before offering the TV idea, as you did in line 34.
